description: This file contains internal number routines for base computations, including multiplication, division, and exponentiation, specifically optimized for an internal base that is a power of 2. It defines functions for multiplying, dividing, and exponentiating numbers represented in a custom format, with detailed handling of mantissas, signs, and exponents.

methods.name: mulnumx
methods.description: Multiplies a number by another number, with optimization to skip multiplication if the second number is 1.

methods.name: _mulnumx
methods.description: Performs the actual multiplication of two numbers assuming the base is BASEX, using grade-school multiplication algorithm.

methods.name: numpowi32x
methods.description: Raises a number to an integer power using repeated multiplication, optimized with binary exponentiation.

methods.name: divnumx
methods.description: Divides one number by another, with a shortcut if dividing by 1.

methods.name: _divnumx
methods.description: Performs the actual division of two numbers assuming the base is BASEX, using a long division algorithm with guess-and-check.
